scenario_description:
Objective: Keep a touring youth matinee load-in on schedule despite uncertain venue access.
Emerging Need: An unsettled vehicle size and a powered-gate fault may invalidate the north-dock route, creating a time-sensitive exposure before the truck arrives.
Decision Context: Assignment records identify the responsible coordinator, while the production handoff defines vehicle thresholds, a nonbinding contingency option, its cutoff, and the later approval path.
Consequence: If the viable alternative disappears after the route conflict becomes clear, the truck may arrive without an admissible unloading route, delaying setup and jeopardizing matinee readiness.

parameter.subject: Preliminary vehicle allocation — Brightwater load-in
parameter.body: The carrier currently expects to send a 16-foot panel van for Thursday's Harborlight load-in. Dispatch is still consolidating equipment, so the final vehicle allocation will not be locked until tomorrow morning.

parameter.title: North dock powered-gate repair validation
parameter.description: Facilities validation following intermittent slow-cycle observations. No dock outage has been declared.

parameter.content: A spot check found an intermittent powered-gate control fault at the north dock. Manual release remains usable for vans, but Facilities cannot clear a box truck until the repair validation finishes Wednesday afternoon.

parameter.subject: Final vehicle manifest — Brightwater load-in
parameter.body: Dispatch has finalized a 24-foot box truck for the Thursday 06:30 Harborlight load-in because the scenery cases could not be split. The carrier has no smaller vehicle available for this run.

parameter.subject: South Curb capacity update — February 5
parameter.body: The February 5, 06:00–08:30 South Curb traffic-marshal slot is now allocated to another venue. The earliest remaining staffed arrival that morning is 08:30.
